a.lede: Move follows admission of affair with woman alleged to be Chinese spy and reported relationship with employee Business live – latest updates Jensen Huang has resigned as chief executive of Nvidia after reports of extramarital affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company employee. He will be replaced on an interim basis by Nvidia’s chief financial officer, Colette Kress,
a.title: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO after alleged affairs

b.lede: A random X poster urged Elon Musk to hire Jensen Huang just hours before the former Nvidia chief resigned from his position.
b.title: Elon Musk says it ‘would be an honor’ to hire ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
